summary: E2E frontend testing of new 'Personas' App (VERA Core) sprint. Verified 10/10 acceptance criteria on preview URL as qa_varela@vera.test. Login → /hoy. Sidebar shows 'Personas' link enabled WITHOUT 'Próximamente' badge (only Operaciones/Studio still show it, as expected). /personas renders the list (data-testid=people-screen, people-table, people-count='3 personas' initially). Instant search filters correctly — typing 'zzz_no_match_xyz' collapses table and shows people-empty state; clearing restores rows. Created 'ZZ Test Persona QA 58943' via NewPersonModal (nombre + teléfono +54 11 5555-9999 + email zztest.qa@vera.test + rol Contacto default). App auto-navigates to /personas/e62c9550-1201-4cca-bebb-2d4bb094cb7f. PersonDetail header shows exact name and 4 tabs (Datos/Relaciones/Conversaciones/Timeline) with correct data-testids. In Datos: toggled rol 'Vendedor' (aria-pressed false→true), set Estado=Inactivo, added extra phone '+54 11 7777-0000' via chip list, clicked Guardar. Reloaded the ficha — role Vendedor=true, status Inactivo=true, and the extra phone chip persisted (data survived reload). Relaciones tab shows relations-empty (persona has no properties). Conversaciones tab shows conversations-empty. Timeline tab shows exactly 1 event with data-testid=timeline-PersonCreated ('Persona creada · 21/07/2026, 02:36 p.m.'). Back on /personas the search 'ZZ Test Persona QA' returns 1 row with Contacto+Vendedor badges and Inactivo status — end-to-end persistence confirmed.

issues: The people-count '<n> personas' text is rendered ABOVE the isLoading check, so during the initial fetch it briefly shows '0 personas' while 'Cargando personas…' is also visible below. Cosmetic — should hide the count (or show a skeleton) while isLoading is true.

action_items: Optional/cosmetic: in PeopleScreen.tsx suppress the people-count paragraph while isLoading is true (or render 'Cargando…' inside it) so users don't see a transient '0 personas' before rows arrive.
Cleanup: delete the QA seed 'ZZ Test Persona QA 58943' (id e62c9550-1201-4cca-bebb-2d4bb094cb7f) via DELETE /api/people/{id} or Supabase once main agent wraps the sprint.
critical_code_review_comments: PeopleScreen.tsx: search is client-side over the enriched list (name/phone/email/phones/emails). Good coverage for the acceptance criterion. If the dataset grows past a few thousand it should move to server-side but for MVP it is fine.

PersonDetail.tsx DatosTab.save() merges primaryPhone into `phones` and primaryEmail into `emails` before persisting — good, keeps invariant that the primary is always inside the list. However the local `phones`/`emails` state on mount FILTERs out the primary in ChipList's values but stores the full array in state; when Save merges again it re-adds primary — this is idempotent thanks to the `!phones.includes(primaryPhone)` guard. OK.
PersonDetail.tsx uses `key={person.id}` on DatosTab so switching persons remounts the form and resets local state — good UX pattern, prevents stale values.

PersonDetail.tsx: after saving there is no re-fetch of the person object; local state (which mirrors the saved payload) plus the setSaved badge is enough, but the header roles/status chips at the top come from `person` (React Query cache) and may not update until invalidation. Verified after a manual reload the change is there — confirms server persistence. Consider queryClient.invalidateQueries(['person', id]) inside useUpdatePerson.onSuccess so the header updates without reload.
PeopleScreen.tsx: the count paragraph is not gated by isLoading (see design_issues) — minor.

NewPersonModal integration: after a successful POST it correctly fires onCreated(person) and PeopleScreen navigates to /personas/{id}. The list is not visibly refreshed on return via back button — again a queryClient.invalidateQueries(['people']) inside useCreatePerson would keep the listing hot. Verified indirectly: a fresh navigation to /personas after creation DOES show the new row, so the query is being invalidated somewhere (likely on window focus). OK.
Accessibility: role='row' on a <button> and role='table' on a <div> is technically correct but screen readers work better with real <table><tr><td>. Not blocking for MVP.
PersonDetail.tsx timeline maps unknown ev.type to {label: ev.type, icon: Clock} — safe fallback, good.
